label: A2B2C5_oP36_62_d_ac_c2d-001
title: Brownmillerite (Srebrodolskite) Brownmillerite (Ca$_{2}$Fe$_{2}$O$_{5}$) Structure
comments:
Brownmillerite typically has the composition Fe$_{2-x}$Al$_{x}$O$_{5}$, but the pure compound, which the ICSD names Srebrodolskite, has been observed. 
 Above 950K this structure transforms into a \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2CD5_oI36_46_b_c_a_b2c-001}{body-centered orthorhombic structure} (Shaula, 2006).  This transformation also occurs in the alloyed compounds when x $>$ 0.56 (Redhammer, 2004). 
 (Shaula, 2006) list the O3 Wyckoff position as (8d), but the coordinates are given for a (4c) site, which gives the proper stoichiometry.
